theorem: For cycle 2-CNF with n>=3: canonical incidence 2-core width k=n and encoding size L=4n. For every fixed real c>0 choose C=ceil(max(1,c)) and n=16*C^2. Then k=16*C^2 > C*(6+2*log2(C)) = C*log2(L), hence 2^k>L^C>=L^c.
consequence: No single fixed constant c can make exhaustive assignment of every canonical source-incidence 2-core variable polynomially admissible for all CNF inputs.
scope_firewall: This falsifies universality only of the fixed-c full-2core enumeration carrier family. Trinity is not falsified; the frozen cycle control is solved by an earlier exact 2CNF/Horn/dual-Horn door.
